title: And Will the Judge Descend
description: And Will the Judge Descend in Tonic Solfa to BOYLSTON, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 6 verses and a piano.
about: Philip Doddridge wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 554.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to BOYLSTON; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: And will the Judge de-scend? And must the dead a-rise And not a sin-gle soul es-cape His all dis-cern-ing eyes?

lines: And not a single soul escape
And, through the numerous guilty throng,
When earth and heaven before His face
Hark, from the Gospel’s cheering sound
Fly to the shelter of His cross

licence: Public domain: Philip Doddridge died in 1751.
credits: Words by Philip Doddridge (1702–1751), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to BOYLSTON by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
